narration: Even when the odds look attractive, going all in can be a mistake. The Kelly criterion asks how much of your capital to risk, not just whether the bet has an edge. In my example, a fifty-fifty bet paying eleven times your stake gives a Kelly fraction of forty-five percent, not a hundred percent. The conclusion depends heavily on your assumptions.
